source.title: The Fabaceae in Northeastern Mexico (Subfamily Papilionoideae, Tribes Amorpheae, Brongniartieae, and Dalbergieae)

provenance_note: New research record; preserves preexisting source extracts, species JSON, photographic files, licenses and attribution; no learner scoring or public site changes.
gap_addressed: 1999 flora supplies a brief comparison, not a full treatment. This 2025 treatment gives species-level vegetative, floral and fruit characters.
source_treatment_location: Taxonomic Treatment, Amorpha roemeriana, text near published web lines 290–299

morphology_directly_reported.leaves: 5–20 cm long; 7–15 leaflets, each ca. 1–3.5 cm long, oblong to elliptic, bicolored; leaflet margins smooth or crenulate
morphology_directly_reported.calyx: Funnel-shaped, with apical gland dots and triangular to toothlike lobes
morphology_directly_reported.flowers: A single purplish banner petal, ca. 5–6 mm long, often emarginate; stamens ca. 10 mm long
morphology_directly_reported.fruit: Oblong legume, ca. 6–7 mm long, glabrous to minutely strigillose and gland-dotted at apex

nomenclature.crosscheck: Kew Plants of the World Online accepts A. roemeriana and lists A. texana as synonym

scope_limits: Measurements from northeastern Mexico taxonomic treatment; do not substitute as proof of Hays-specific phenotype or distribution
The 2025 treatment's basionym sequence has an apparent chronological anomaly, so preserve original published text but do not promote a basionym assertion without nomenclatural check
Earlier 1999 comparative leaf venation details remain cited separately
integration_flag: Use source-stated species characters with caution; no public learner edits made
